name: Shrydus Industries Ltd
about: Incorporation in 1983, Shrydus Industries Ltd is in the business of healthcare, pharma, real estate and green energy[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SIL (formerly VCK Capital Market Services Ltd) is an integrated and diversified corporate group which has ventured into multiple businesses. It was into Agricultural Commodities and Healthcare products business and is now diversifying in Pharmaceutical Formulation Plant, Astra Lifecare Pvt. Ltd., and Green Energy sector

pros: Stock is trading at 0.26 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -14.0%
